title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in NextScripts…
description: A stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in NextScripts social-networks-auto-poster-facebook-twitter-g plugin versions up to 4.4.8. This vulnerability allows improper neutralization of input during web page generation, potentially enabling attackers to inject malicious scripts. The flaw affects versions through 4.4.8, with no specific fixed versions provided. The vulnerability has a high severity rating with a CVSS score of 7.1.
